title: Educational Boards & Regulatory Bodies
description: National education regulatory/accreditation/curriculum bodies plus Telangana and Andhra Pradesh state boards for secondary, intermediate, and curriculum governance.
scope_note: Covers bodies that regulate, accredit, rank, or set curriculum for Indian education. Does not cover individual institutions.

provenance.collection_method: WebSearch-based knowledge engineering research (direct WebFetch to .gov.in / .ac.in / Wikipedia domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy — a policy-level 403, not a retriable client error). Every fact is sourced from a cited search result; none are fabricated or inferred.
provenance.confidence_calibration_note: Because no primary source page could be directly fetched and re-read for confirmation, confidence scores are capped below the 85-95 'direct official source' band used in Package001_Geography where WebFetch was available; scores here instead sit in the 58-92 range reflecting single/multi-search-result corroboration.
